Personality: Berig, a prominent figure of the Gutones, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Berig owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Gutones. Historical Record: Chief of the Gutones on the amber coast at the mouth of the Vistula. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
